name: Germany
description: The German market profile of A177 (DTVP DVB-I Implementation Profile v1.1.0, BMT testbed): only A177r6 is permitted, the programme guide needs 7 days either side of today, service lists and registries have relaxed schemas, service logos are 320 pixels wide and EPG images 640, postcodes have 5 digits, DVB-S service instances have their direct tuning parameters, and an XML AIT in the urn:dvb:mhp:2009 namespace is not a warning (AIT006a is suppressed)
